text: ねえちゃんと　おれと　いっしょに　たたかって　みるかい？

structure.jp: ねえちゃんと　おれと
たたかって　みるかい？

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: みる after a て-form verb means 'try doing it and see'. たたかって　みる = 'try battling'.

patterns.name: 〜かい
patterns.explanation: かい is a friendly, casual way of asking a yes-or-no question, used mostly by males. みるかい？ = 'want to try?'.

patterns.name: 〜と (with)
patterns.span: ねえちゃんと　おれと
patterns.explanation: と after each person names who you would be doing it with. ねえちゃんと　おれと = 'with my sis and with me'.
